F-027 NEW, P1, FIXED THIS CYCLE — Steve's and Vanessa's voices did not speak. Root cause: browsers only permit speechSynthesis while the page holds user activation, which expires seconds after a click; a chat reply arrives 5-20s later, so speak() was being called with activation already expired and silently did nothing inside the embedded artifact. Remediated: voicePrime() now runs ON the send click and on the voice toggle (unlocking the engine for the session), a Test voice button gives an explicit unlocking gesture, a 2.6s watchdog reports on screen when audio is still blocked instead of leaving silence, and a diagnostics line under each voice control reports Claude runtime / speech support / voices loaded / unlocked / microphone in the actual viewing browser.
